name: select_and_store_flagged_result
description: Calls two subroutines in sequence, then branches on a 16-bit state word; both branches call one more routine and store its byte result into a fixed field of the same state block.

name: advance_entry_accumulators
description: Walks a table of 16-bit entries, skipping negative ones, and for each live entry adds a companion value into two accumulator tables, advances a third table by a fixed step of 14, and decrements the entry's counter. A conditional prefix calls routines when a state word is zero, and a global counter is decremented on wrap.

name: reset_long_table_and_counters
description: Clears a longword state field and two word counters, fills a 501-entry longword table with minus one, and sets a timer-like field to a base value plus 3000.

name: wait_four_vertical_blanks
description: Calls the graphics library's WaitTOF routine four times in a loop, pausing until four vertical-blank frames have passed.

name: run_clamped_frame_sequence
description: Runs a 69-iteration loop that waits for the blitter, steps four bounded 16-bit counters with clamping at zero, 200 and 199, and occasionally calls a helper. It then fills a table with minus one, polls a check over 200 iterations, and resets two state words when the check succeeds.

name: initialise_fixed_point_matrices
description: Writes 16384, a fixed-point value of one, and zeros into several blocks of 16-bit fields laid out as 3-by-3 matrices. The pseudo-code shows only these constant stores, with no comparisons.

name: transform_pair_and_commit
description: Stores two input components, multiplies them through a fixed-point coefficient table with a scale-by-four and high-word shift to produce six result words, then copies nine words of the result into the working block.

name: transform_pair_negated_and_commit
description: Computes six fixed-point products from two inputs, negating the first input for part of them, against a coefficient table. It writes the results into a block and copies nine words of it into the working block.

name: compose_transform_with_differences
description: Computes three fixed-point differences and three sums of two inputs against coefficient fields, copies three constant fields into the output, and copies nine words of the result into the working block.

name: test_four_plane_separations
description: Tests the state position against up to four plane-like entries in a fixed-stride table and keeps the smallest separation. When none of the first four entries clears the 99 margin it stores a scaled value and returns a failure code; otherwise it returns the chosen index and a projected value from a second coefficient set.

name: compute_normalised_offset_vector
description: Initialises a block of state words, then computes three difference components between a stored position and an input position, normalises them by a magnitude returned from a helper, and scales the result by a stored gain. It then adds a second correction built from averaged table entries to the three output fields.

name: find_first_plane_within_margin
description: Tests a position against up to four plane-like entries in a fixed-stride table and returns the index of the first entry whose separation is 99 or less. If all four exceed that margin it returns a failure code, and it also flags a large negative final separation.

name: repeat_helper_until_limit
description: When three state flags have a specific combination, it sets a limit word and repeats a helper call until a counter passes the limit or a state word changes, using a different loop when a signed value is positive. It then clears one state flag and sets another to minus one when a value is nonzero.

name: initialise_global_state_words
description: Clears a 175-entry word table and many state words, fills 40 coefficient entries using helper calls, and sets fixed starting values such as 160 and 100 and the limits 12000 and 9000. It ends with helper calls and a flag-dependent branch, and the pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: initialise_state_block_fields
description: Writes the same kind of initial values as its global-address counterpart, clearing word tables, filling 40 coefficient entries through helper calls, and setting starting values such as 160 and 100. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through, so the final branches are not visible.

name: stage_global_and_run_helpers
description: Stores one state word into a global, calls a helper, then reassigns the global from a second value and makes a run of seven further helper calls.

name: latch_value_after_helper_steps
description: Makes seven helper calls, stores a 32-bit global value into a state field, then makes two more helper calls.

name: wrap_phase_and_derive_offsets
description: Reads a global step value and adds it to a table entry selected by a state index, subtracting the stored limit once if the sum reaches it. It then derives several scaled fields from the result, the limit and the step.

name: select_colour_set_by_sign
description: Chooses one of two fixed sets of four 16-bit words according to the sign of a state word, writes it into a table at offsets 2 to 8, and sets three counters to 12 or 3 to match.

name: run_helpers_with_swapped_pointer
description: When a state word is negative, it saves two context pointers, temporarily swaps in another pointer, and runs a short sequence of helper calls with fixed arguments. It then restores the saved pointers.

name: reset_text_cells_and_timer
description: Writes space characters into six cells of the text buffer, increments a counter, sets several state words to minus one or zero, and sets a 32-bit field to a base value plus 180000.

name: build_entry_records_from_table
description: Initialises state fields, then builds a linked list of entry records by looping over a count taken from a flag. For each record it stores a link, a clamped non-negative difference from a table, a helper-derived value and a large 32-bit sentinel.

name: reinitialise_linked_entry_records
description: Walks the existing linked list of entry records, giving each a sequential index and recomputing its clamped difference from a table. It also resets the record's flags and sentinel values.

name: dispatch_command_character_loop
description: Repeatedly reads a character code from a helper and branches on letter and tab values, calling a different handler for each, with counter and flag updates on every pass. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through, so later branches are not visible.

name: prepare_standings_row_text
description: Sets up a results-style screen state, then copies one character per entry from a name table into a row buffer, padding unused cells with spaces. It runs a timed wait of 18 or 36 passes depending on a flag, and the referenced text includes RACE RESULTS.

name: record_lowest_value_entry
description: Walks a linked list of entries to find the one with the smallest 32-bit value field. If that value is below the stored best for the current slot, it saves the value and copies ten name bytes from the entry into the slot's record.

name: store_best_entry_for_slot
description: Compares a saved entry's 32-bit value with the best value stored for the current slot. If it is smaller, it updates the stored value and copies ten name bytes from the entry into the slot's record.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: The decompiled body is an immediate return with no operations, although the listing reports 126 instructions and ten calls. The recovered code is therefore a stub, and its behaviour cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: run_three_helpers_when_idle
description: When two state words are zero, it calls three helper routines, and the same three calls are made whether or not a third word is set; the third word only changes whether it returns early. The referenced text is for qualifying and positions labels, but no text drawing is visible here.

name: run_two_helpers_when_clear
description: When three state words and one more word are all zero, it calls two helper routines and otherwise does nothing. The referenced text is LEAD TIMER, but no timer code is visible in this routine.

name: add_fifteen_to_counter_field
description: Calls two helper routines, then adds 15 to a 32-bit counter field. The listing shows only these operations although the facts report 14 calls, so the rest of the routine is not visible here.

name: run_frame_command_loop_variant
description: A variant of the frame-driven command loop that reads a character code and branches on the letter q and other values, with counter and flag updates on each pass. It is only reachable through a gap in the static flow, and the pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: store_entry_words_for_slot
description: Walks up to six linked entries, copying each entry's first word into a per-slot table with an 18-byte row stride and adding a delta from a global array to a field of each entry. It then advances the slot index.

name: update_wrapped_angle_and_position
description: Adjusts an angle-like state word from four input flags using shifted step values, and wraps it into a 360-unit range. It then computes a weighted sum of three table entries against per-slot coefficients, applies scaled offsets to several state words, and performs a threshold check; the pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: advance_state_check_threshold
description: When a flag is set, it advances three state words and wraps the first into a 360-unit range. It then computes a three-term weighted sum and compares it with a stored threshold, either clearing a flag or copying nine words into a snapshot block; the pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: store_wrapped_angle_pair
description: Wraps an incoming angle-like value into a 360-unit range and stores it with a second input and a summed third value into state words, clearing the third word when a flag is set. The listing then runs into a long routine that is cut off partway through, which does not match the five-instruction count in the facts.

name: store_pair_and_update_position
description: Wraps a negative angle-like value into range, stores it with two more inputs into state words, then computes a weighted sum of table entries to compare with a stored threshold. The listing is cut off partway through.

name: update_speed_and_audio_volumes
description: Updates a speed-like state word from throttle-style flags with damping and clamps, then computes per-channel volume values. The facts show these values are written to the two audio volume registers, but the listing is cut off before those writes are visible.

name: update_audio_period_from_speed
description: Computes a period value from a speed state word, clamps it between 299 and 810, and writes it to the two audio period registers through global words. It then runs a countdown that toggles a flag and calls helper routines.

name: update_stick_velocity_from_flags
description: Reads a packed input-flag byte; when its top bit is clear it adjusts two velocity-like words by a bounded step with damping and sets a mode word, and otherwise it records a single-direction latch.

name: decode_joystick_port_flags
description: Decodes the joystick port movement word into a packed flag byte in the state block, deriving four direction bits from exclusive-or pairs of movement bits and a button bit. The facts identify the source as joystick movement and fire status, and the top bit is set when the fire line is clear.

name: update_entry_positions_from_table
description: Iterates over a linked list of entries and advances each entry's position from a table indexed by the current segment, applying a damped correction and checking the entry against a list of thresholds. It sets a flag when an entry reaches the current segment index. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: update_entries_audio_channel_two
description: Loops over entry records with a countdown and, when the countdown expires, adjusts a value and writes the channel-two audio period and volume from state words. For each active entry it tests against the current segment index, steps velocity-like fields and calls a helper. The listing is cut off partway through.

name: register_entry_crossing_event
description: Compares an entry's 32-bit timestamp with the current time and ignores events closer than 400 units. Otherwise it advances the entry's counter and sets a bit in a mask word, and when the counter is positive with a state flag set it adds 30 to a 32-bit field. The referenced text is QUALIFYING.

name: update_frame_countdown_speed
description: Subtracts a speed-scaled amount from a countdown word and clears a related flag when it goes negative. It adds a minimum step to two position words under a condition, selects a value from a table to set a level word, and makes helper calls gated by state flags.

name: advance_sequence_phase_and_reset
description: Advances a phase counter when a countdown expires or at a fixed interval, with bounded busy-wait loops at the sixth phase. It then clears several state words and copies the current clock value into each entry's timestamp field.

name: signal_phase_change_and_wait
description: Sets a code byte from the current phase and calls a helper, then waits until a counter reaches zero before making a second helper call with a fixed code. Its callers are not named, so the codes' meaning is not established.

name: update_status_indicators_per_frame
description: Each frame it compares two position words with a band of 180 to 224 and toggles indicator flags through helper calls, checks a timer word and a lead-related table entry, and clamps a position word to 225 while halving a speed word when it exceeds 224. The referenced text is IN LEAD, POSITIONS and WARNING, and the listing is cut off partway through.

name: call_helper_return_entry_pair
description: Calls one helper routine and returns the 64-bit register pair that was passed in on entry, so the routine works as a thin wrapper with no visible result of its own.

name: offset_coordinates_temporarily
description: Saves two coordinate words, adds a value from a helper minus 24 to each around a set of helper calls, and then restores the two original words.

name: route_result_by_magnitude
description: Calls a helper and, when a global flag is set and the returned high word is positive, calls one of two helpers depending on whether that value is below 2. Otherwise it calls a different helper, and it returns the helper's 64-bit result.

name: start_timed_event_once
description: When a state word is zero, it optionally sets a global code of 12 and calls a helper, increments the state word, sets a timer to a base value plus 5000, and calls a helper.

name: reset_event_timer_from_table
description: Clears a 32-bit timer field and two state words and sets a counter to 15. It computes a timer from a base value, five times a table value and four times a helper result, and sets a flag when a table byte is nonzero.

name: reset_timed_counters_to_defaults
description: When a state word is positive it sets a global code of 13 and calls a helper. It then sets a counter word to minus 15, two 32-bit counters to minus one, and clears a flag word.

name: run_frame_sync_key_check
description: Runs one frame of the main loop: it updates a time value from a frame counter, calls graphics-library routines (LoadView, WaitBOVP, WaitBlit and WaitTOF, per the facts) and runs a helper. When a state word is set it reads a character code and handles the letters L, T and P, plus the asterisk, which toggles a flag. The referenced text is PIT STOP.

name: forward_stack_pair_after_helper
description: Calls one helper routine and returns an 8-byte value taken from the caller's stack. The facts report two calls, but the listing shows only one.

name: accumulate_point_segment_lengths
description: Walks a list of three-coordinate points, computing differences between consecutive points, squaring them and adding a helper's result to a running total stored in a state word. It then fills two more arrays of squared differences and returns the total.

name: compute_normalised_cross_product
description: Forms two edge vectors from three stored points indexed by a value and computes their cross product with a right shift. It divides each component by a helper's magnitude, treated as at least 1, and stores the three results through output pointers.

name: interpolate_clamped_path_points
description: Computes step deltas between successive path points and, for each segment, divides them by a helper-derived step count to write interpolated points into an output table. A secondary value is clamped to plus or minus 90 and advances in steps of 10 per point until the last control point is reached.

name: compute_per_slot_timing_values
description: Derives a scaled speed value from a table entry and a stored value, defaulting to 3000 when zero, and computes a percentage-style value from a 32-bit accumulator. For each slot record it writes that percentage plus a fixed offset of minus 48 with a floor of 10, then halves a state word.

name: load_initial_state_from_tables
description: Sets a flag word to minus one and zeroes a global word that the facts link to the channel-two volume register. It loads position words and their negations from a table, then copies seven 32-bit table pointers into the working state and clears per-frame counters.

name: set_flag_minus_one_helper
description: Calls one helper routine, then sets a state word to minus one.

name: restore_saved_state_from_copies
description: Restores seven saved 32-bit fields to their working globals and reinstates the table pointers. It then sets three position words and their negations from helper outputs and clears several counters.

name: stub_no_operation_handler
description: The decompiled body is an immediate return with no operations, although the facts report it as a handler target. The recovered code is therefore a stub, and its behaviour cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: stub_no_operation_routine
description: The decompiled body is an immediate return with no operations, while the facts report one call. The recovered code is a stub, and its behaviour cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: stub_no_operation_entry
description: The decompiled body is an immediate return with no operations, although the facts report 64 instructions. The recovered code is a stub, and its behaviour cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: rotate_pair_table_by_one
description: Shifts a table of 8-byte pairs down by one place, moving the first pair to the end, with the count taken from a state word minus one.

name: format_time_into_result_text
description: Writes a single slot digit, copies ten name characters from a record into the text buffer, and formats a halved 32-bit time as minutes, seconds and two fractional digits with a colon and a point. The digits are stored as ASCII characters.

name: format_time_into_row_buffer
description: Copies ten name characters from a record into a row buffer at a location derived from the slot index, then writes a space and formats a halved 32-bit time as minutes, seconds and two fractional digits as ASCII digits in place.

name: draw_glyph_into_bitplanes
description: ORs eight rows of a glyph table into up to four bitplanes spaced 4000 words apart, using a bit shift from the column parity. Each plane is written only when its bit is set in a mask word, and drawing is skipped unless a position value lies between 20 and 90.

name: draw_count_markers_max_four
description: Writes a code of 13 into a text cell and calls a helper for each counted position, up to four, descending from a state count. It then sets a final cell to 3.

name: copy_word_advance_six
description: Copies one state word into another and adds six to a third state word.

name: draw_lap_rows_from_count
description: When a state count is nonzero, it calls helpers and then loops from twelve down to zero, drawing one row per index with a helper call and returning the last 32-bit result. The referenced text is AVERAGE LAP and LAP TIMES.

name: format_six_digits_or_blank
description: If a 32-bit value lies within a fixed range, it writes six ASCII digits from state bytes into fixed text cells. Otherwise it writes spaces into those cells.

name: copy_nine_chars_call_helper
description: Copies nine bytes from a source pointer into a global text buffer and then calls a helper routine.

name: format_number_with_state_digits
description: Formats a value as two digits, reducing it modulo 100 and blanking a zero tens digit, then fills five further text cells with digits taken from state bytes.

name: split_time_into_digit_globals
description: Splits a halved 32-bit time into minutes, held modulo 100, and into seconds and fractional digits. It stores each part as separate digit values in global bytes.

name: format_and_draw_elapsed_time
description: Formats the halved difference between a clock value and a stored start time into minutes, seconds and fractional digits. It then draws the digit glyphs into bitplanes at a computed screen position when a position value is in range.

name: stub_immediate_return_slot
description: The decompiled body is an immediate return with no operations, although the facts report it as a handler target. The recovered code is a stub, and its behaviour cannot be determined from this evidence.

name: call_helper_two_pointers
description: When a state word is nonzero or another word is zero, it calls a helper twice, setting a context pointer to a different fixed value before each call and restoring the original pointer afterwards.

name: draw_remaining_count_value
description: Stores four layout parameters in state words, then derives a count from either a position limit minus a stored value or a clamped stored value. It draws the tens digit when nonzero and the units digit through helper calls.

name: format_entry_lap_numbers
description: Walks the linked entries and writes each entry's one-based number as two digits into text cells, together with its name bytes, then blanks four trailing cells. The referenced text is NO. LAP.

name: assign_entry_sort_keys
description: Finds the smallest 16-bit field across the entry list, excluding one special entry, and sets each entry's 32-bit key from a scaled value divided by that entry's own field. The special entry gets a fixed key of 65000 or 60000 depending on the sign of a state word.

name: find_entry_format_name_row
description: Searches the entry list for the entry whose id matches a key, writes its one-based number and five name characters into text cells, and uses a placeholder pattern when its value is the sentinel. It returns zero when found and minus one when not.

name: advance_cycling_entry_row
description: Advances a cycling index with wrap-around, finds the entry at that ordinal in the list and writes its one-based number and five name characters into text cells. A placeholder pattern is used when its value is the sentinel, and the function returns minus one when no entry matches. The referenced text is QUALIFYING.

name: advance_focus_entry_index
description: When two state words are zero, it advances a focus index with wrap-around to the next entry, copies that entry's value into a state word, and sets two flag words to minus one and zero.

name: format_entry_value_row
description: Writes a sign character, the entry's name code and a value divided by 20 as digits with a decimal point into text cells. The sign is plus for one special entry and minus for the others, and leading zero digits are blanked.

name: sort_entry_list_by_position
description: Repeatedly passes over the linked list of entries and swaps adjacent entries when the first has a smaller composite position value, until a pass makes no swaps. The composite combines a position word with a scaled offset word, and one special entry uses a state position instead.

name: update_entry_clock_offsets
description: Updates a clock-offset field from the current time. It either recomputes that field from a scaled value times a position difference while clearing a set of state words, or clears a per-entry pair and recomputes the clock field from the same scaled difference.

name: sort_entries_by_ascending_key
description: Repeatedly passes over the linked list of entries, swapping adjacent entries whose 32-bit key is larger than the next one's, until a pass makes no swap. It returns one if any swap was made and zero otherwise.

name: check_segment_crossing_progress
description: Finds the segment whose stored threshold the current weighted position has crossed, updating the current segment index and related flags. It then runs the same per-frame event handling as the main loop, and the pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: trigger_once_on_transition
description: When two state words are zero, it calls a helper once when a per-segment byte falls to one or below and a timer condition holds. It sets or clears a small latch word on each pass so the helper runs only on transitions.

name: dispatch_helper_by_mode_value
description: Calls one helper when a mode word equals 3, a second when it is neither 1 nor 3, and a third when it equals 1.

name: forward_call_to_helper
description: Calls one helper routine and returns, with no other work.

name: record_lap_time_and_advance
description: Records the current timing value into a per-lap table when the lap index is between zero and 99, adds it to a running total, sets a flag bit and advances the lap index. When the final lap is reached it falls into the same per-frame event handling as the main loop, and the pseudo-code is cut off partway through. The referenced text is QUALIFYING.

name: run_post_event_frame_update
description: Resets frame counters and, when a state value is nonnegative, chooses between a short wait branch and a full update. The full update reassigns positional state from saved words, compares a timing count against a threshold of 100, and tallies per-entry counters and status flags. The referenced text is PLEASE WAIT and WARNING, and the listing is cut off partway through.

name: ease_position_over_eight_steps
description: Moves the position words toward a target in eight equal steps, copying a saved set of words and calling helpers on each step. It finishes by storing the final position and clearing a speed word, and it stops early when a flag indicates the sequence has been interrupted.

name: blend_entry_ramp_audio_volumes
description: When a flag is set it loads position words from a table entry and clears state words. Otherwise it blends a value toward a target over eight steps, writing per-step values through globals that the facts link to the four audio volume registers. The referenced text is PLEASE WAIT, and the listing is cut off partway through.

name: load_positions_and_clear_state
description: Loads three position words and their negations from table entries selected by the current index, then clears a block of per-frame state words.

name: clear_per_frame_state_words
description: Clears twelve state words that hold per-frame position, counter and flag values.

name: offset_coordinates_by_half_input
description: Saves two coordinate words, adds a helper value minus half of an input value to each, calls helpers, then restores the saved words.

name: ease_position_with_target_steps
description: Runs an eight-step loop that copies nine words from a block and calls helpers, then a nine-step loop that moves the position toward a table target. The second loop also steps another word by minus 150 per step and writes the final position back.

name: ease_position_with_ramped_step
description: Resets a state word and moves the position words toward a table target over nine steps. Each step increments a speed-like word by ten and adds 37 to another word, then calls helpers and writes the final position back.

name: advance_frame_and_run_helpers
description: Increments the frame counter and makes helper calls, with extra helper calls gated by two state flags.

name: clear_pair_and_run_helpers
description: Makes three helper calls, clears two state words, then makes five more helper calls.

name: setup_frame_loop_start_state
description: Resets a block of state words, calls helper and blitter routines, and sets timing and position fields before entering a frame loop. The loop increments the frame counter and runs helpers every eighth frame. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: poll_sound_load_with_timeout
description: Sets a few sound-related globals, then polls a helper and a status byte until either responds or a timeout of 12000 units passes, and then halts in an endless loop. The referenced text is the DF0 PDData Sounds3 data path.

name: poll_input_tab_then_reset
description: Resets a set of global state words and polls a character-input helper, ending the loop on a tab code or a status change. It then clears flags and returns minus one, and the facts also link the routine to the graphics-library WaitTOF call.

name: clear_memory_via_blit_stub
description: Calls three helper routines, one of which is a library stub that invokes the graphics library's BltClear routine. The referenced text is a short quoted fragment.

name: advance_path_segment_and_bounce
description: Advances to the next record of a 24-byte-stride path table, loading position and offset words, and reflects two velocity words when positions cross fixed screen limits. When the segment counter reaches four it finishes the sequence, clears flags and returns minus one.

name: blend_nine_words_by_ratio
description: Computes a fixed-point blend fraction from two inputs and copies nine words between blocks. It then blends each word of one block with the other using that fraction and writes the result back.

name: next_index_with_wrap
description: Returns the input index plus one, wrapping back to zero when it reaches the stored count.

name: pass_through_helper_call
description: Calls one helper routine and returns its result unchanged, with no other work.

name: call_two_helpers_in_order
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: compute_face_normal_for_index
description: Forms two edge vectors from three stored vertices, using the previous index when the index equals a stored count. It computes their cross product with a right shift, divides each component by a helper magnitude, and writes the normal and related components into state words before returning the index.

name: restore_word_copy_nine_words
description: Saves a state word and restores it after a helper call, sets a negated copy into another word, and calls a helper. It then copies nine words from one block to another and clears a counter word.

name: record_elapsed_frames_lap_time
description: Computes the frames elapsed since the previous call and, when the lap counter is not negative, stores that count as a lap time, accumulates it, and updates a best-time field if it is faster and above 500. When a flag condition holds it calls helpers with fixed arguments, and it returns the elapsed count.

name: swap_pointer_around_helpers
description: When a flag condition holds, it calls a helper twice with the context pointer set to two different fixed values and restores the original pointer afterwards.

name: set_layout_parameters_then_draw
description: Stores four layout parameters into state words and calls two helper routines.

name: draw_indexed_entry_swap
description: When a flag and a status bit are both clear, it swaps in a fixed context pointer and calls a helper with fixed coordinates and a value looked up from a table by a state field. It then makes further helper calls under two other pointer values.

name: forward_two_helper_calls
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: project_track_samples_into_arrays
description: Projects a sequence of table samples through three coefficient rows into three coordinate arrays and a fourth table. It then runs an interpolation pass that clamps and divides values for each sample. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: insert_entry_into_sorted_bucket
description: Places an entry into the first free slot of a four-slot bucket chosen by a position word, then bubble-sorts the bucket so its slots stay ordered by a 32-bit key.

name: shift_history_words_and_draw
description: Decrements a state word by 32, shifts two history word pairs down by one slot, and calls one of two helpers depending on whether the low nibble of a register value is zero.

name: choose_helper_by_low_nibble
description: Calls one of two helper routines depending on whether the low four bits of a register value are zero.

name: select_handler_by_clamped_index
description: Computes an index from a state word, clamps it to 127, scales it and dispatches to one of two indirect targets after a comparison. The jump tables could not be recovered, so the dispatch targets are unknown.

name: emit_fixed_code_when_idle
description: When four state conditions hold, it swaps in a fixed context pointer and calls a helper with two fixed constants, then restores the pointer.

name: emit_fixed_code_alt1
description: Uses the same four-condition gate as its neighbours, swapping in a fixed context pointer to call a helper with 285 and a different fixed constant, then restoring the pointer.

name: emit_fixed_code_alt2
description: Uses the same four-condition gate as its neighbours, swapping in a fixed context pointer to call a helper with 285 and a further fixed constant, then restoring the pointer.

name: emit_fixed_code_alt3
description: Uses the same four-condition gate as its neighbours, swapping in a fixed context pointer to call a helper with 285 and a further fixed constant, then restoring the pointer.

name: step_slot_countdown_copy
description: Computes a per-slot value from a stored position and table entries, copies nine words of table data into the working block and copies a 60-word block. It then steps a countdown for the slot that bounces between limits, and writes a value the facts link to the fourth audio volume register.

name: toggle_marker_table_entries
description: When a flag is set, it toggles a pair of table entries between zero and twelve and sets three companion words to twelve or clears them. Otherwise it toggles one entry at an offset from a state word between zero and twelve.

name: drain_while_helper_nonzero
description: Repeatedly calls a helper and, while its result is nonzero, calls a second helper.

name: set_default_layout_values
description: Sets two layout words and four 16-bit values of 20, 175, 53 and 74 into state words, then copies two of them into companion words.

name: init_state_and_dispatch_commands
description: Resets a set of display and timing state words, then copies ten name characters into three text buffers, substituting spaces for terminators. It then enters a command-dispatch loop that returns a fixed value of 12345 on a terminal condition and branches on small key codes. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: init_options_screen_and_dispatch
description: Resets state words and display globals, loads a view through the graphics library, and runs the same name-copy and command-dispatch sequence as its neighbour. The referenced text includes the artwork path DF0 PDArtWork Options and the name NEWMARK. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: run_two_helper_steps
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: write_index_digit_into_label
description: When a flag is clear it makes one helper call. When the flag is set it writes the one-based index as an ASCII digit into a label cell chosen from a table, then makes one helper call. The referenced text is the artwork path DF0 PDArtWork TuneUp.

name: set_pointers_and_run_helpers
description: Sets several context pointers to fixed values, runs a sequence of helper calls with pointer swaps between them, and makes an extra helper call when a state word is set. The referenced text is the artwork path DF0 PDArtWork Options.

name: reset_view_and_layout_state
description: Sets two flags to minus one and clears an active flag, then sets layout and timing words to fixed values such as 3, 0, 20, 200, 30 and 254. It calls the graphics library's LoadView through a vector and returns the previous flag value.

name: run_menu_key_dispatch_loop
description: Waits for a helper to return zero, then loops on key codes. Codes 1 and 2 advance two menu indices with wrap-around, codes 3 and 4 move a third index, codes 5 and 6 move a fourth, codes 7 and 8 move a value by five within bounds, and codes 9 and 10 step another value between zero and 35. The referenced text is DF0 PDArtWork TuneUp.

name: run_menu_dispatch_from_start
description: Initialises a slider word to one, adding one when the low bit of a register value is set, then runs the same key-code dispatch loop as its neighbour until a terminal code is seen.

name: set_context_pointer_call_helpers
description: Sets a context pointer to a fixed value, clears a second pointer, and makes six helper calls.

name: compute_menu_display_geometry
description: Computes four geometry words from menu indices and a table value, then sets three sizing words from one of three presets selected by a mode index.

name: copy_table_rows_and_dispatch
description: On first entry it advances a counter, copies six-byte rows from a table into twelve text buffers chosen by a page index, and resets a slider and several indices. It then runs a key-code dispatch loop that returns a fixed value of 12345 on a terminal code and the state index otherwise. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: sort_four_entries_by_score
description: Bubble-sorts four index entries in descending order of the 16-bit score word at a fixed offset in each entry's record, repeating passes until no swap occurs. It then sets a state word to one.

name: format_ranked_name_rows
description: For each of five ranked entries, copies a ten-character name into a row buffer with an 18-byte stride, then writes the entry's score as three digits with leading zeros blanked. The referenced text is a set of name strings.

name: init_menu_state_and_dispatch
description: Clears a flag, sets a value to five and runs a helper sequence, then enters a key-code dispatch loop. The loop returns a fixed value of 12345 on a terminal code and the state index otherwise, and it saves and restores display positions around a redraw. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: conditional_helper_on_index_five
description: Makes three helper calls, one more when an index equals five, and then a final helper call.

name: emit_status_row_pointer_pair
description: Sets four layout parameters of 1, 13, 10 and 113, then calls a helper with the context pointer set to two different fixed values.

name: draw_value_row_pointer_swap
description: Calls a helper twice with a state value and the fixed numbers 6 and 124 under one context pointer, then makes two more helper calls under a second pointer, restoring the original afterwards.

name: forward_single_helper_call
description: Calls one helper routine and returns.

name: draw_two_digit_number_glyphs
description: Splits an input value into tens and units digits, stores them in a buffer, and draws their glyphs into bitplanes at a computed position when a position value lies between 20 and 90.

name: run_two_helpers_two_pointers
description: Calls two helpers under one context pointer and two more under a second pointer, restoring the original pointer afterwards.

name: delegate_to_single_helper
description: Calls one helper routine and returns.

name: pass_control_to_helper
description: Calls one helper routine and returns.

name: call_three_helpers_return_input
description: Calls three helper routines and returns the 16-bit input register value that was passed in on entry.

name: set_panel_parameters_and_draw
description: Sets four 16-bit values of 166, 172, 52 and 90 and four layout parameters of 13, 161, 17 and 166, makes two helper calls, and returns its input register unchanged.

name: set_alternate_panel_and_draw
description: Sets four 16-bit values of 109, 115, 52 and 90 and four layout parameters of 13, 104, 17 and 109, makes two helper calls, and returns its input register unchanged.

name: poll_input_for_menu_selection
description: Polls input codes and a status word in a loop. It returns a fixed value of 12345 after about 18000 units of idle time, returns an index for key codes 6, 7 or 28, and otherwise tests the pointer position against nine rectangular areas before selecting one. The facts also link the routine to the graphics-library WaitBOVP call.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one with no other work. The listing is a single return, so this is a stub with no further behaviour to describe.

name: read_digit_then_init_dispatch
description: Reads a character from a helper and stores its digit value in a state word, then runs the same display reset, name copy and command-dispatch sequence as its neighbour. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: clear_flag_after_two_helpers
description: Calls two helper routines and then clears a flag word.

name: flag_minus_one_after_helpers
description: Calls two helper routines and then sets a flag word to minus one.

name: poll_pointer_menu_eleven_areas
description: Loops over input and pointer state. Key code 14 triggers a helper call, and key codes 7 and 28 set a direction word to plus or minus one. The pointer is tested against eleven rectangular areas, and the index of a hit is returned with its coordinates. The facts link the routine to the graphics-library WaitBOVP call.

name: poll_menu_or_digit_selection
description: Reads a character: Q or q returns minus one, and a digit below 12 selects that index after a helper call. Otherwise it runs the same pointer-hit loop over eleven rectangular areas as its neighbour.

name: return_minus_one_immediately
description: Returns minus one with no other work. The listing is a single return, so there is no further behaviour to describe.

name: draw_indexed_marker_pointer_pair
description: Looks up two coordinates from a table by index. When a flag for that index is nonnegative, it calls a helper with those coordinates under one context pointer, then calls another helper under a second pointer.

name: draw_indexed_marker_alt_table
description: Looks up two coordinates from a second table by index and, when the index's flag is nonnegative, calls a helper under one context pointer and another under a second pointer.

name: draw_flagged_marker_by_index
description: When a flag for an index is nonnegative, looks up two coordinates from a table by that index and calls a helper under one context pointer, then calls another helper under a second pointer.

name: draw_flagged_marker_second_table
description: When a flag for an index is nonnegative, looks up two coordinates from a second table by that index and calls a helper under one context pointer, then another under a second pointer.

name: call_helper_each_index_down
description: Calls one helper once for each index from the starting value down to zero.

name: format_elapsed_time_digits
description: Computes half the elapsed time since a stored start value, then writes its minutes, reduced modulo 100, and seconds as ASCII digits into fixed text cells with a colon between them.

name: draw_status_block_when_flagged
description: When a flag word is set and a status bit is clear, it clears the flag, sets four layout parameters of 12, 161, 14 and 190, and calls helpers under two context pointers.

name: set_status_layout_and_draw
description: Sets four layout parameters of 12, 161, 14 and 190 and calls helpers under two context pointers, restoring the original pointer afterwards.

name: draw_timed_banner_when_clear
description: When several state words are clear, it stores a frame-based timer value plus an offset, sets layout parameters of 166, 194, 48 and 60 and of 12, 161, 14 and 190, optionally waits for the graphics library's WaitTOF routine, and calls helpers under two context pointers.

name: draw_secondary_banner_layout
description: When a status bit is clear it sets two sets of layout parameters, waits for the graphics library's WaitTOF routine if a state word is set, and makes two helper calls.

name: draw_text_stream_word_wrap
description: Reads characters from a text stream, stopping at terminator, space or newline bytes. It converts lowercase letters to capitals, draws each glyph through a helper, advances the pen six rows per line, and wraps lines at a width limit. The pen position is saved at the end.

name: draw_text_stream_with_layout
description: Derives four layout parameters from the pen state, then draws a text stream with the same glyph, line-wrap and pen-saving loop as its neighbour.

name: draw_text_stream_from_pen
description: Draws a text stream from the saved pen position using the same glyph, line-wrap and pen-saving loop as its neighbours.

name: read_line_into_buffer
description: Blanks a 16-cell buffer, then reads characters from an input helper until a carriage return. Backspace codes remove the previous character, lowercase letters become capitals, and the result is terminated with a zero byte.

name: run_intro_sequence_with_audio
description: Resets flags and timers, then waits for a status word to clear. It runs timed loops of 64, 100 and 64 passes that call helpers and write values through globals linked to the first two audio volume registers, with the graphics library's WaitTOF used for timing. The referenced files are the First and PitBack artwork and the Cheer sound.

name: run_frame_input_timers
description: Runs one frame by resetting pointers and timers, calling helpers for position updates, then reading input codes. The codes L, T, P, E, O, digits 1, 3, 4, 6 and 8, the asterisk and space each adjust state, and the referenced text is PIT STOP. The listing is cut off partway through.

name: run_frame_input_loop
description: Runs the per-frame input loop: it advances a frame counter and handles key codes such as L, T, P, E, O, digits 1, 3, 4, 6 and 8, the asterisk and space. It returns minus one when Q is pressed under a status condition, and the listing is cut off partway through.

name: run_frame_input_loop_entry
description: Calls one helper, then enters the same per-frame input loop as its neighbour.

name: set_lead_timer_deadline
description: When two state words are clear, it points a text field at a global buffer and stores the current clock plus 30 as a deadline. The referenced text is IN LEAD.

name: set_text_deadline_after_helper
description: Calls a helper, then points a text field at a global buffer and stores the current clock plus 45 as a deadline. The referenced text is LAP TIMES.

name: set_position_text_deadline
description: When two state words are clear, it makes two helper calls under a context pointer for one of two text cases, points a text field at a global buffer, and stores the current clock plus 30 as a deadline. The referenced text is POSITIONS and QUALIFYING.

name: toggle_flag_scale_timer
description: When a state word is zero, it toggles a flag. When the flag turns on it clears two position words and halves a scale word, and otherwise it doubles the scale word. Either way it points a text field at a global buffer and stores the current clock plus 30 as a deadline.

name: double_scale_and_set_deadline
description: Doubles a scale word, points a text field at a global buffer, and stores the current clock plus 30 as a deadline.

name: run_seventeen_helper_steps
description: Makes seventeen helper calls in sequence and returns.

name: wait_for_audio_then_helper
description: Calls a helper and, when its result is nonzero, calls a second helper, waits until a status word clears, and makes one more call.

name: call_pair_of_helpers
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

name: run_frame_event_loop_entry
description: When a state word is nonzero and a helper result and two flags allow, it swaps a context pointer, calls helpers and enters a per-frame event loop that updates timers, sound and text buffers. The pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: select_six_slot_entries
description: Chooses between two table entries for each of six slots according to the low bits of a state word, calls a helper for each slot, and makes two indirect library calls at the end. It returns early when a state flag is set, and the pseudo-code is cut off partway through.

name: write_geometry_table_pairs
description: Writes fixed 32-bit packed coordinate pairs into two geometry tables, one entry at a time, with no helper calls.

name: draw_fifteen_entry_panel
description: Sets two panel words, then draws fifteen table-driven entries with helper calls at a fixed x of 160. It waits until a status word clears, sets two words to 160 and 53, and makes two final helper calls.

name: blink_flag_twenty_six_passes
description: When a flag word is nonzero it runs a 26-pass loop that every fourth frame calls a helper and negates the flag when the helper returns zero, with two further helper calls per pass.

name: call_helper_when_flag_set
description: Calls one helper routine when a flag word is nonzero.

name: draw_seventeen_entry_panel
description: Sets panel words from a table and fixed values, runs a 55-pass loop of helper calls, and sets two words to 160 and 53. It then draws seventeen table-driven entries, waits for a status word to clear, and makes a final helper call.
